_real_world.class: Telephonics AN/APS-153 multi-mode maritime surveillance radar
_real_world.variant_scope: AN/APS-153 as fitted to MH-60R Seahawk (ISAR, periscope detection, surface search)
public_equipment: AN/APS-153 multi-mode radar: ISAR, periscope detection (NAVAIR-confirmed fit, csg-us-mh60r-navair-frp, Tier A)

_provenance.modeling_note: MH-60R primary radar for ASW/ASuW (periscope detection, ISAR imaging, surface search). The CSG order-of-battle page's residual R18 states no public detection range exists for APS-153. All numeric sensor fields are proxy values copied from the existing repo mh60r_mvp.json inline mounted_sensors entry ('helo_surface_search_radar_mvp'), which models the same helicopter-class surface-search radar role at 65 km / 300 deg FOV; this record makes that radar an explicit, separately named Sensor module per the task's requirement rather than leaving it as an inline anonymous block, with detection_prob nudged up slightly to reflect APS-153's dedicated periscope-detection/ISAR design intent (not a quantified figure).

sensor.max_range.note: proxy from repo mh60r_mvp.json inline mounted_sensors radar block (65000.0 m); no public APS-153 detection range (OOB page residual R18, authority_blocked)

sensor.fov_deg.note: proxy from repo mh60r_mvp.json inline radar block (300.0 deg)

sensor.scan_period.note: proxy from repo mh60r_mvp.json inline radar block

sensor.detection_prob.note: engineering_estimate marginally above repo mh60r_mvp.json's 1.0-capped baseline reduced to 0.95 for a synthetic non-calibrated record; reflects APS-153's dedicated periscope/ISAR role qualitatively (NAVAIR A confirms the modes, not a detection probability)
